verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-facing rule engine in Google Calendar for defining triggers that run actions automatically on events. Push notifications, ACL watch and incremental sync tokens are developer building blocks for constructing such automation externally, not the capability itself. Automatic email-to-event adding is a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
